# TuneIn
> TuneIn is an internet audio platform for streaming live radio, news, sports, music, podcasts, and audiobooks.

TuneIn aggregates live AM/FM stations, national networks, sports talk, podcasts, and spoken-word programming into a single listening platform. The site emphasizes browseable radio categories, local and global station discovery, and premium listening options.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://tunein.com/): Main entry point for listening to live radio, news, sports, music, and podcasts.
- [Radio](https://tunein.com/radio/): Browse live radio stations, categories, and featured streams.
- [Podcasts](https://tunein.com/podcasts/): Discover podcast shows across news, sports, comedy, business, and more.
- [Audiobooks](https://tunein.com/audiobooks/): Explore audiobook listening options and spoken-word content.
- [Premium](https://tunein.com/premium/): Subscription offering with expanded sports, news, and commercial-free listening benefits.

## Radio Categories
- [Music](https://tunein.com/radio/Music-r101/): Live music radio stations and genre-based listening options.
- [News & Talk](https://tunein.com/radio/News--Talk-r101232/): News radio, talk programming, and current events stations.
- [Sports](https://tunein.com/radio/Sports-r101257/): Sports radio stations, commentary, and live game-related audio coverage.
- [By Location](https://tunein.com/radio/local/): Find local radio stations by city, state, or region.
- [By Language](https://tunein.com/radio/languages/): Browse stations and shows organized by broadcast language.

## News & Talk Stations
- [CNN](https://tunein.com/radio/CNN-s20406/): Live CNN audio stream for breaking news and analysis.
- [FOX News Radio](https://tunein.com/radio/FOX-News-Radio-s20431/): National news and talk radio from FOX News Radio.
- [MSNBC](https://tunein.com/radio/MSNBC-s90191/): Live MSNBC audio programming and political news coverage.
- [Bloomberg Radio](https://tunein.com/radio/Bloomberg-Radio-s24940/): Business, markets, and financial news radio stream.
- [CNBC](https://tunein.com/radio/CNBC-s110052/): Financial news and market coverage from CNBC audio programming.

## Sports Listening
- [Sports Radio](https://tunein.com/radio/Sports-r101257/): Central hub for sports stations, leagues, and talk shows.
- [ESPN Radio](https://tunein.com/radio/ESPN-Radio-s2219/): National sports talk and live event coverage from ESPN Radio.
- [WFAN Sports Radio](https://tunein.com/radio/WFAN-Sports-Radio-1019-FM660-AM-s32682/): New York sports talk and live local coverage.
- [College Sports](https://tunein.com/radio/College-Sports-r101269/): College football, basketball, and campus sports audio streams.
- [NFL on TuneIn](https://tunein.com/radio/NFL-c100000889/): NFL-related radio, talk, and game coverage on TuneIn.

## Podcasts
- [Podcasts Home](https://tunein.com/podcasts/): Browse featured and trending podcasts across major categories.
- [News Podcasts](https://tunein.com/podcasts/News-c100000006/): News podcast directory for daily briefings and analysis.
- [Sports Podcasts](https://tunein.com/podcasts/Sports--Recreation-p100000003/): Sports podcasts covering teams, leagues, and commentary.
- [Business Podcasts](https://tunein.com/podcasts/Business--Economics-p100000014/): Business and economics podcasts for markets, careers, and strategy.
- [Comedy Podcasts](https://tunein.com/podcasts/Comedy-p100000001/): Comedy podcast listings from stand-up, interviews, and improv shows.

## Audiobooks
- [Audiobooks Home](https://tunein.com/audiobooks/): Main audiobook browsing page for spoken-word listening.
- [Fiction Audiobooks](https://tunein.com/audiobooks/Fiction-c100001690/): Fiction audiobook listings across popular literary genres.
- [Mystery Audiobooks](https://tunein.com/audiobooks/Mystery-c100001699/): Mystery and suspense audiobook selections.
- [Science Fiction & Fantasy Audiobooks](https://tunein.com/audiobooks/Science-Fiction--Fantasy-c100001703/): Speculative fiction audiobook catalog.
- [Biography & Memoir Audiobooks](https://tunein.com/audiobooks/Biography--Memoir-c100001686/): Biographical and memoir audiobook titles.

## Local & Regional Discovery
- [Local Radio](https://tunein.com/radio/local/): Discover stations near a listener’s city or region.
- [United States Radio](https://tunein.com/radio/USA-r101301/): Browse radio stations available across the United States.
- [Canada Radio](https://tunein.com/radio/Canada-r101302/): Explore Canadian radio stations and regional broadcasts.
- [United Kingdom Radio](https://tunein.com/radio/United-Kingdom-r101304/): Listen to UK radio stations and national broadcasters.
- [Australia Radio](https://tunein.com/radio/Australia-r101305/): Access Australian radio stations and local programming.

## Music Discovery
- [Music Radio](https://tunein.com/radio/Music-r101/): Browse music stations by format, mood, and popularity.
- [Classic Rock](https://tunein.com/radio/Classic-Rock-r101111/): Classic rock radio stations and artist-focused streams.
- [Country](https://tunein.com/radio/Country-r101005/): Country music stations with contemporary and classic programming.
- [Hip Hop](https://tunein.com/radio/Hip-Hop-r101009/): Hip hop and rap radio stations from local and national broadcasters.
- [Jazz](https://tunein.com/radio/Jazz-r101007/): Jazz radio stations featuring standards, contemporary, and instrumental programming.

## Account & Platform Information
- [Sign In](https://tunein.com/login/): User login for saved stations, subscriptions, and personalized listening.
- [Sign Up](https://tunein.com/signup/): Create a TuneIn account for favorites and cross-device access.
- [Get the App](https://tunein.com/get-tunein/): Download TuneIn apps for mobile and connected devices.
- [Support](https://help.tunein.com/): Help center for account, billing, device, and playback issues.
- [Advertise](https://tunein.com/advertise/): Information for advertisers and audio campaign opportunities.
